title: IMERG Final Monthly Precipitation — Philippines subset
unitNote: Monthly mean precipitation rate, not accumulated rainfall.

grid.layout: uint16 little-endian [month][lat][lon], lat south->north, lon west->east

quality.appDerived: availability = valid | partial | missing, computed by GeoOrchestra from fill values and coverage

source.access: NASA GES DISC GPM_3IMERGM V07B via Earthdata Cloud OPeNDAP (opendap.earthdata.nasa.gov, collection C2723754851-GES_DISC)
source.citation: Huffman, G.J., E.F. Stocker, D.T. Bolvin, E.J. Nelkin, J. Tan (2023), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, Greenbelt, MD, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07

preparation.missingRule: values equal to _FillValue -9999.9 or negative are missing; never converted to 0
